## Checklist

- [ ] Added exactly one file: `registry/apps/<slug>.json`
- [ ] Filename matches the `slug`, and the slug is a single DNS label
- [ ] `build.ref` is pinned to a full commit SHA (source-build only)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally, or I'm happy to let CI tell me
- [ ] The repo I'm pointing at is public

See [docs/ADDING-AN-APP.md](../docs/ADDING-AN-APP.md) if anything above is unclear.
